SIM Price 100 Tk
Start-up Bonus: Get 50 voice minutes , 50 SMS & 5GB data with 30 days validity after first 50Tk recharge after activation of Bornomala SIM . Recharge amount 50Tk will be added to main balance.
Pay per use rate 1Paisa/15KB.
Recharge Bonus: by recharging Tk 30, customer will get-30 (On-net) minutes, 30 (On-net) SMS and 60 MB. Validity: 3 days. Tk 30 will be added to subscriber’s main account balance. Subscribers will get this offer once in every  7 days .
Registering for Bornomala SIM:
Registering for Bornomala SIM:
Register for Bornomala SIM from any Teletalk number as per the following SMS Format:- Please type: BORSSC_Board(First 03 letters)SSC_RollSSC_YearSSC_Registration_NoContact_No and send to 16222. (SMS charges applicable)
Example: BOR MYM 123456 2026 1234567 0155XXXXXXX
N.B: After successful registration, You will get an ID and OTP. You can buy Bornomala SIM from any Teletalk Customer Care showing this ID, OTP and NID no.
